| [Process First-Aid Kit](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Capture an ad-hoc plant process issue (a ramp-up problem, a trouble-shooting case, an unexplained process behaviour) in a structured first-aid request - problem made S.M.A.R.T., process and machine, what data exists, which of the two data scenarios applies, who benefits - and route it either to Analytical Support (a one-off insight) or to use case intake (a recurring need), or back as a data gap. Drafts the request; does not install devices or commit cost. Use when a plant raises a process issue and there is no use case yet, when someone asks for the Process First-Aid Kit, or when a one-off analytical request must be scoped before analysis starts. Also absorbs the retired Analytical Support Service lane: ad-hoc analytics now routes to Lane 1 self-service, Lane 2 or external support. |
